data.exact_reserve_text: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes the reserves were strengthened by $4.1m in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding decreased during 2023 (from 138.7 to 113.6 in the report currency). The managing agent refined reserving methodology during the year which was accounted for prospectively and resulted in a net strengthening of reserves of $4.1m. Overall claims experience was favourable in 2023 (a relatively quiet weather-related natural catastrophe season), contributing to an improvement in the claims ratio and net reserve outcome, with the methodological change being the primary driver of the explicitly stated reserve movement.
raw_causal_phrases: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves.
These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate.
As a result of these changes the reserves were strengthened by $4.1m in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).
The claims ratio of syndicate 6107 has improved to 34% in 2023 (2022: 53%) mostly due to a relatively quiet weather related natural catastrophe season during the year.

The decrease in reinsurance premium year on year relates to a reduction in previously accrued reinstatement premiums associated with Hurricane Ian and re-estimations of reinsurance premium payable on proportional reinsurance contracts.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (prior years 2021 & earlier) was provided. The report explicitly states a $4.1m strengthening but specifies this is 'on a net of reinsurance basis' - this NET figure has been used as a fallback for prior_year_development_gbp_m because no gross movement note was located. Gross premium mix percentages were taken from a statement of premium mix (percentages of gross premiums earned) and applied to total gross written premium as a pragmatic approximation. A gross claims development triangle is present in note 9, but parsing alignment in the provided text was ambiguous; triangle is included in _claims_triangle for reference.
